Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step to keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- Objective: Suncrest wants to reduce inference latency for real-time recommendation features while keeping unit cost predictable.
- Primary constraint: data residency for user profiles in US regions; secondary: tight SLOs for p95 latency.
- Stakeholders: engineering (Sofia Chen), product (you), and security/compliance later in the process.

Proposed next step: 30-minute product orientation where we walk through:
1) Redwood runtime and how we hit sub-100ms p95 on similar workloads
2) deployment options (hosted, dedicated) and cost levers
3) a short Q&A for Sofia and any infra folks you want to include

Can you please pick one of the following 30-minute windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 22 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed Jul 23 — 14:00–14:30
- Thu Jul 24 — 09:30–10:00

If none of those work, share two times that do and we’ll adapt. I attached a one-pager that frames the agenda and success criteria.

Next steps on our side: Rishi will join to cover the infra/ops questions and share a short demo agenda we typically use.

Thanks,
